_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tag', "color" TEXT NULL, "image_path" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "books" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "original_title" TEXT NULL, "author" TEXT NOT NULL, "isbn" TEXT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "original_language" TEXT NULL, "translator" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "cover_url" TEXT NULL, "total_pages" INTEGER NULL, "current_page" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "ownership_status" TEXT NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "book_format" TEXT NULL, "collection_name" TEXT NULL, "collection_number" INTEGER NULL, "cover_path" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "publish_year" INTEGER NULL, "collection_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "imprint_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "copies" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "pagination_config" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "open_library_edition_key" TEXT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reading');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_tags" ("book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "collection_number" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shelves" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "filter_query" TEXT NULL, "filter_subtitle" TEXT NULL, "filter_author" TEXT NULL, "filter_publisher" TEXT NULL, "filter_isbn" TEXT NULL, "filter_language" TEXT NULL, "filter_translator" TEXT NULL, "filter_collection" TEXT NULL, "filter_collection_ids" TEXT NULL, "filter_status" TEXT NULL, "filter_tag_ids" TEXT NULL, "filter_imprint_ids" TEXT NULL, "filter_no_cover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("filter_no_cover" IN (0, 1)), "filter_boolean_query" TEXT NULL, "filter_search_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "filter_format" TEXT NULL, "filter_ownership" TEXT NULL, "filter_notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shelf_tags" ("shelf_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES shelves (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("shelf_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shelf_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES shelves (id), "collection_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tags (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pages_read" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sections" TEXT NULL, "read_number" INTEGER NULL, "is_backfill" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_backfill" IN (0, 1)), "medium" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text', "start_position" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stat_widget_configs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "goal_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES reading_goals (id), "config" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "read_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "read_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "sections" TEXT NULL, "progress" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "segment_progress" TEXT NULL, "audio_progress" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "audio_segment_progress" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ownership_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_name" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "query" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audiobook_info" ("book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "narrator" TEXT NULL, "platform" TEXT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "identifier" TEXT NULL, "pagination_config" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id"));
